entities.summary: Tengiz Iremadze (b. 1973-03-09, Sukhumi) was a philosopher or thinker of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sukhumi and Georgia. Known in the fields of georgia, philosophers & thinkers, asia.
